svg.title: Spend on the causal question.
svg.desc: Actual seed 42 finite-model simulation. B probe has graph information 0.693 nats but query information 0. The selected A probe has query information 0.289 nats. Six simulated experiments spend 12 units and produce a zero-effect claim conditional on the four models, equal prior, known likelihoods and perfect interventions. No real-world causal proof.
